display_fil:
Walang sabon sa station.
Kumpleto ang training attendance.
Attendance ay hindi patunay ng supply o practice.
display_en:
No soap at the station.
Training attendance is complete.
Attendance does not prove supplies or practice.
narration_fil: Sa practice inspection, walang sabon sa handwashing station. May kumpletong attendance sheet ng training. Sabi ng kasama, “Okay na tayo dahil lahat ay dumalo.” Nakita ni BHW Aya na magkaiba ang attendance, supply at aktuwal na gawain. Ano ang dapat niyang itala?
narration_en: During a practice inspection, the handwashing station has no soap. The training attendance sheet is complete. A colleague says, “Everyone attended, so we are fine.” BHW Aya recognizes that attendance, supplies and actual practice differ. What should she record?

display_fil:
Tiyak na nakita + lugar + oras.
Iulat at sundin ang pansamantalang kaayusan.
Gagawin + tao + follow-up.
Panukat: may sabon at gumaganang station?
display_en:
Specific observation + place + time.
Report and use the safe interim arrangement.
Action + owner + follow-up.
Measure: soap and a working station?
narration_fil: Itala ang tiyak na nakita, lugar at oras. Ipaalam ang kakulangan sa responsable at sundin ang pansamantalang ligtas na kaayusan. Magkasundo sa gagawin, tao at follow-up. Pumili ng panukat na makikita: may sabon ba at gumagana ba ang station? Huwag ipagpalagay na kumpleto ang practice dahil may attendance.
narration_en: Record the specific observation, place and time. Report the gap and follow the agreed safe interim arrangement. Agree on an action, owner and follow-up. Choose an observable measure: is soap available and does the station work? Do not infer complete practice from attendance.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

options.fil: Tamad ang lahat kaya tiyak na mali ang kanilang gawain.
options.en: Everyone is lazy, so their practice is certainly wrong.
Station A, nine o’clock: no soap.

options.fil: Lahat ay mahusay dahil may pirma sa attendance sheet.
options.en: Everyone is competent because the attendance sheet is signed.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Bansag ito at hindi tiyak na observation. 2: Malinaw ang nakita, lugar at oras. 3: Hindi sapat ang attendance para malaman ang aktuwal na practice.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is a label rather than a specific observation. 2: This identifies what was seen, where and when. 3: Attendance cannot establish actual practice.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Alas-nuwebe: walang sabon sa Station A.
Nurse: refill at pansamantalang station.
Pagbalik: sabon at gumaganang tubig.
Itala ang ebidensiya, pati kung hindi naayos.
display_en:
Nine o’clock: no soap at Station A.
Nurse: refill and interim station.
Follow-up: soap and running water.
Record evidence, including unresolved gaps.
narration_fil: Tala ni Aya: “Station A, alas-nuwebe: walang sabon.” Ipinaalam sa nurse, na nagtakda ng refill at pansamantalang station. Sa pagbalik, may sabon na at gumagana ang tubig. Isinulat ang petsa at ebidensiya. Kung hindi pa naayos, “hindi pa naayos” ang ilalagay at muling ipaaalam.
narration_en: Aya records: “Station A, nine o’clock: no soap.” The nurse arranges a refill and an interim station. At follow-up, soap and running water are available. Aya records the date and evidence. If unresolved, she records that honestly and reports it again.

display_fil:
Sundin ang observation at privacy rules.
Clinical audit: awtorisadong staff.
Exposure o agarang panganib: iulat agad.
Quiz ay hindi procedure observation.
display_en:
Follow observation and privacy rules.
Clinical audits: authorized staff.
Exposure or immediate hazard: report promptly.
A quiz is not procedure observation.
narration_fil: Sundin ang lokal na observation at privacy rules. Hindi awtomatikong awtorisado ang BHW na magsagawa ng clinical audit o mag-imbestiga ng outbreak. Iulat agad ang exposure o agarang panganib; huwag hintayin ang petsa ng routine follow-up. Ang quiz completion ay hindi kapalit ng naobserbahang procedure.
narration_en: Follow local observation and privacy rules. BHWs are not automatically authorized to conduct clinical audits or investigate outbreaks. Report exposures or immediate hazards promptly rather than waiting for routine follow-up. Quiz completion does not replace observation of a procedure.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi pa na-refill ang sabon sa follow-up. Ano ang dapat itala?
check.prompt_en: Soap has not been refilled at follow-up. What should be recorded?

options.fil: Tapos na ang gawain dahil may nangakong magre-refill.
options.en: The task is complete because someone promised a refill.

options.fil: Walang problema dahil may naunang training ang lahat.
options.en: There is no problem because everyone received training.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Pangako ay hindi ebidensiya ng resulta. 2: Hindi pinapalitan ng training ang kailangang supply. 3: Tapat ang tala at may susunod na aksyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: A promise is not evidence of completion. 2: Training does not replace the needed supply. 3: The record is accurate and prompts further action.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_fil:
May resulta at ebidensiya.
Sa Lunes: subukan ang improvement card.
Monitoring: suriin gamit ang iisang batayan.
display_en:
A result with evidence.
On Monday: use the improvement card.
Monitoring: check against agreed criteria.
narration_fil: Naayos ang supply gap at may ebidensiya ng follow-up. Sa Lunes, gamitin ang blangkong improvement card sa fictional na station kasama ang supervisor. Salita: monitoring — paulit-ulit na pagsusuri gamit ang napagkasunduang batayan. Ihiwalay ang alam, nakita at kailangan pang suriin.
narration_en: The supply gap is addressed with follow-up evidence. On Monday, use a blank improvement card for a fictional station with the supervisor. Word: monitoring — repeated checks using agreed criteria. Distinguish what is known, observed and still unverified.
